source: User steering while the first facts review was open
request: Allow improvements to limits in the current disequality and injectivity encoding when they help EggCC or make reasoning more complete, including propagating a remaining child difference after other children are known equal.
clarification: For f(a,b) != f(c,d) and a = c, the conclusion is b != d. This follows from congruence; it does not require f to be injective.
proposedFact: Improvements to the encoding are in scope when they help an EggCC case or close an explicitly defined reasoning gap; assess remaining-child disequality propagation and schedule closure, with automated edge-case checks for implemented changes and no claim of unrestricted completeness.
